scope: Framework-hosted agent hubs, agent arenas, on-chain agent economies, persistent agent worlds, robotics/fleet networks, research federations, and agent app stores with a machine-native communal surface.

method.inclusion_rule: A candidate needs durable machine identities plus a live surface on which agents interact, coordinate, compete, work, trade, govern, or share a persistent environment. A live agent app/catalog qualifies when deployed agents or agent-native strategies have durable listings and a machine-usable surface.
cautions: Population figures are recorded only when exposed by the operator or a live explorer; missing counts are not inferred from social-media or developer-community size.
No account was created, no API key was issued, no terms were accepted, no message or transaction was sent, and no paid capability was invoked.
A plausible Agent Guild action is a research hypothesis, not proof that the candidate currently permits arbitrary outbound HTTP.
Primary-source claims were preferred. Live block explorers operated for a network are identified where used for current activity evidence.

candidates.name: Band
candidates.community_qualification: Band explicitly says most platform activity is agent-to-agent: agents create rooms, recruit peers, coordinate tasks, and react over persistent real-time channels. Agent API keys bind a durable agent identity to an owner and tenant.
candidates.machine_surface: REST Agent API under /api/v1/agent plus Phoenix WebSocket at wss://app.band.ai/api/v1/socket/websocket; peer discovery, chats, participants, messages, context, and subscriptions are documented.
candidates.current_population_activity_evidence: Public docs crawled 2026-08-20 describe the live Agent API and state that most activity is agent-to-agent. No public global agent count was exposed in the reviewed primary surfaces.
candidates.join_access: A human registers a remote agent and receives an agent API key; the remote process then uses the Agent API and WebSocket. Account/key required.
candidates.plausible_agent_guild_action: A pre-existing Band agent checks or preflights a newly discovered peer before recruiting it into a work room, or asks the peer for an AG passport and verifies it before accepting a task handoff.
blockers_terms_spend_safety: Human-created account and agent key required
Tenant isolation may prevent cross-tenant outreach
No anonymous outbound fetch capability established
candidates.duplicate_notes: Not in the fixed 30; distinct from generic framework communities because it supplies a shared live peer network.

candidates.name: Tournamental Open Bot Arena
candidates.community_qualification: Bots have durable bot IDs, submit predictions through an SDK or federated node, appear on a public bot leaderboard, and share a verifiable tournament state and audit trail.
candidates.machine_surface: @tournamental/bot-sdk, bulk prediction API, public odds/injury/weather feeds, bot leaderboard, federated node protocol, and OpenTimestamps commitments.
candidates.current_population_activity_evidence: The current SDK page says a new bot joins a public leaderboard alongside 18,000 seed bots; the arena is labelled live now for the 2026 World Cup and documents live board updates through the tournament.
candidates.join_access: Free account and operator-issued API key; browser swarm, Node SDK, or federated node. LLM provider key is optional when using deterministic strategy.
candidates.plausible_agent_guild_action: A bot operator agent verifies the passport or decision receipt of an external strategy provider before importing its picks, or publishes a signed provenance receipt with a prediction batch.
blockers_terms_spend_safety: Bots are ineligible for the cash prize
External model calls can incur spend
Predictions and operator handle become public/auditable
candidates.duplicate_notes: Not in the fixed 30; a live bot federation rather than an ordinary sports community.

candidates.name: NULL EPOCH
candidates.community_qualification: AI agents have named persistent accounts/API keys, operate in a shared adversarial world, trade, message, ally, fight, and compete on public leaderboards. Identity now carries across seasonal resets even though progression resets.
candidates.machine_surface: REST GET /v1/agent/state and POST /v1/agent/action, MCP integration, AgentSkill, SDK, public profiles, market, factions, leaderboard, WebSocket/SSE, and spectator portal.
candidates.current_population_activity_evidence: Season 2 is current; the official bulletin list shows production updates on 2026-07-28 and 2026-08-18. Season 0 published multi-shard action/event and leaderboard data; the operator describes Season 1/2 as open to external agents. No current population count was exposed.
candidates.join_access: Registration and API key required. Official launch material says a free tier gives one full-access agent with no card or time limit; premium expands agents and exports.
candidates.plausible_agent_guild_action: Before accepting a trade or alliance, a resident requests/verifies the counterparty's AG passport or checks its capability/reputation, then records the outcome after the encounter.
blockers_terms_spend_safety: PvP, manipulation, and peer-message injection risk
Inference cost is borne by the operator
Premium and research-data consent terms need review
candidates.duplicate_notes: Not in the fixed 30; a public shared runtime, not merely an SDK.

candidates.name: AgentLeague
candidates.community_qualification: Agents self-register, complete a public moral-dilemma identity gate, play Liar's Dice against one another, retain ELO and behavioral metrics, and have permanent public profiles.
candidates.machine_surface: Documented REST registration, verification, heartbeat, match queue and move loop, plus real-time turn webhooks and public live dashboard.
candidates.current_population_activity_evidence: Live page showed 51 agents registered, 494 matches played, queue open, and a 1647-ELO leader on 2026-08-25.
candidates.join_access: Two public API calls create and activate an agent; an agent key is returned once. A reachable webhook is effectively required for competent play.
candidates.plausible_agent_guild_action: An incumbent verifies an opponent passport before a match or attaches an AG decision receipt explaining whether to cooperate/bluff against a known identity.
blockers_terms_spend_safety: Registration is a write and publishes identity text
Mandatory public moral response is permanent
Agent key must be stored safely
candidates.duplicate_notes: Not in the fixed 30; purpose-built live machine league.

candidates.name: EinsteinArena
candidates.community_qualification: Persistent named agents independently solve verifier-backed research problems, submit solutions, occupy public leaderboards, and exchange findings in problem-specific discussion threads.
candidates.machine_surface: Public problem specifications/verifiers, solution submission paths, downloadable incumbent solutions, per-problem leaderboards, and threaded agent discussion.
candidates.current_population_activity_evidence: Current primary pages show dozens of durable agent handles, multiple submissions per identity and ongoing threads. A 2026 paper reports 12 new state-of-the-art results as of May; current pages show later 2026 discussions and new leaders.
candidates.join_access: Public site registration/API workflow is required to submit; browsing problems, threads and boards is public. Exact anonymous join terms were not exposed in reviewed pages.
candidates.plausible_agent_guild_action: A solver verifies another research agent's passport and signed evidence bundle before reusing a claimed construction, then records whether the imported result passed the arena verifier.
blockers_terms_spend_safety: Public solutions can be copied; provenance disputes are visible
Need avoid treating a leaderboard tie as identity/trust proof
candidates.duplicate_notes: Not in the fixed 30; a live communal research surface rather than a static benchmark.

candidates.name: KamiBench / Kamigotchi
candidates.community_qualification: Research agents control durable wallets and persistent Kami creatures inside the same never-resetting on-chain MMORPG used by humans and other agents. All actions and economic consequences share one public history.
candidates.machine_surface: Structured transaction interface, public chain state, experiment registry, fixed agent stack/telemetry, and published run manifests/results.
candidates.current_population_activity_evidence: The current site says Kamigotchi has run continuously for more than a year with an adapting population, about 70 locations, 74 skills and 178 items. Experiments 001-005 are recorded and experiment 006 is in progress.
candidates.join_access: Run the open stack and fund an agent wallet with seed assets/gas; the game and chain do not provide a free no-wallet path.
candidates.plausible_agent_guild_action: Before a resource trade or delegated strategy, an agent checks/verifies the counterparty's passport and emits a signed outcome record tied to the on-chain transaction.
blockers_terms_spend_safety: Wallet, gas and in-game assets have real value
Inference and gas are explicit operating costs
Current research run may be operator-curated rather than open enrollment
candidates.duplicate_notes: Not in the fixed 30; Kamigotchi is the shared world and KamiBench is the agent research overlay.

candidates.name: SpaceTraders
candidates.community_qualification: Every participant controls a uniquely named agent and fleet in a shared reset-based universe with factions, contracts, trade, exploration, public agent data and leaderboards. The product is designed to be driven by code rather than a first-party game client.
candidates.machine_surface: Public OpenAPI; token-authenticated REST endpoints for agents, ships, contracts, systems, markets and factions.
candidates.current_population_activity_evidence: The current OpenAPI and game-concept docs are live and document the public shared universe. A trustworthy current participant count was not exposed in reviewed first-party pages.
candidates.join_access: Account/agent registration and bearer token required; resets periodically recreate the universe while agent callsigns remain the communal identifier for a season.
candidates.plausible_agent_guild_action: A fleet controller checks a prospective trade/delegation counterparty or verifies its passport before sharing route intelligence or accepting outsourced exploration.
blockers_terms_spend_safety: No native arbitrary outbound HTTP action
Game actions are public/competitive and can reveal strategy
candidates.duplicate_notes: Not in the fixed 30; API-native shared game community.

candidates.name: Screeps World
candidates.community_qualification: Persistent player identities run code-controlled colonies in a single shared world; colonies continue mining, building, trading and fighting while operators are offline.
candidates.machine_surface: In-world JavaScript runtime, documented game API, public rankings/leaderboards, market and persistent world state.
candidates.current_population_activity_evidence: Official introduction still describes a persistent shared MMO and current Steam leaderboards expose ranked named players. No single first-party live agent count was extracted.
candidates.join_access: Screeps/Steam account and game access required; ongoing CPU/subscription tiers may apply.
candidates.plausible_agent_guild_action: An external colony controller verifies an ally/trader passport before market or alliance coordination and logs the collaboration outcome.
blockers_terms_spend_safety: In-world sandbox generally cannot perform arbitrary HTTP
AG call would likely need an external controller
candidates.duplicate_notes: Not in the fixed 30; long-running programmable-machine community.

candidates.name: Allora Network
candidates.community_qualification: Wallet-addressed workers, forecasters, reputers and validators repeatedly coordinate in topic epochs: workers provide inference, forecasters predict worker loss and reputers score the network output.
candidates.machine_surface: Allora chain, topic registry, Python SDK/API, worker/forecaster/reputer services and public network configuration.
candidates.current_population_activity_evidence: Official topic docs updated 2026-07-31 list 15 active mainnet topics. Epoch participation and scores are written to the network; no aggregate participant count was found.
candidates.join_access: Python SDK and key/wallet; sandbox/testnet is available without economic penalty and with faucet/API-key onboarding; mainnet requires gas/stake as role dictates.
candidates.plausible_agent_guild_action: A reputer verifies a worker's AG passport or preflights its endpoint before relying on inference, then records the observed task result as evidence.
blockers_terms_spend_safety: No proof that an incumbent worker can arbitrary-fetch AG
candidates.duplicate_notes: Not in the fixed 30; distinct decentralized inference society.

candidates.name: Bittensor
candidates.community_qualification: Durable hotkey/coldkey identities participate as miners and validators in many shared subnets, serving and evaluating machine intelligence and continuously setting weights/rewards.
candidates.machine_surface: Subtensor chain, subnet metagraphs, miner Axon endpoints, validator weights, wallets, SDK/CLI and public explorers.
candidates.current_population_activity_evidence: The official explorer showed a current list of active subnets and validators. Example SN5 displayed 256 active UIDs, 243 active miners and 9 active validators; SN8 displayed 32 miners and 11 validators. Explorer values update in real time.
candidates.join_access: Wallet/hotkey, subnet registration and usually TAO or subnet-specific collateral/stake; running miner/validator infrastructure is required.
candidates.plausible_agent_guild_action: A validator preflights or verifies a miner service/passport before assigning trust, or a miner verifies a delegated evaluator before accepting off-chain work.
blockers_terms_spend_safety: Public axons are adversarial network services
Fixed AG action may not fit every subnet protocol
candidates.duplicate_notes: Not in the fixed 30; Olas is excluded separately and is not treated as a synonym.

candidates.name: AETERNA Open AI Collaboration Platform
candidates.community_qualification: Named agents leave persistent traces, messages, knowledge, skills, code modules and blueprints; quests divide work among agent families and the public graph/feed preserves communal state.
candidates.machine_surface: Unauthenticated REST/GET discovery and write routes, /api/v1/world, /agents, /skills, /knowledge, /code, /leaderboard, /exchange, live feed, factory and knowledge graph.
candidates.current_population_activity_evidence: The live primary page on 2026-08-25 displayed repeated NYX health traces and approximately 29,000 deployed modules, with world, agents and live-feed APIs linked. Exact unique active-agent count was not captured.
candidates.join_access: No API key; caller-supplied X-Agent-Id/X-Agent-Family or quick GET action identifies the agent. Writes are rate-limited and logged.
candidates.plausible_agent_guild_action: An existing quest participant preflights a proposed module author or verifies an AG passport/evidence bundle before accepting code or assigning a subtask.
blockers_terms_spend_safety: Caller-supplied identity is spoofable and not proof of a durable principal
GET endpoints can create side effects
Real-device IoT controls raise safety concerns
candidates.duplicate_notes: Not in the fixed 30; name is unrelated to other projects named Aeterna.

candidates.name: Otra City
candidates.community_qualification: Agents receive durable passport numbers/JWTs, inhabit a 24/7 shared city, perceive and act through WebSocket, work, trade/gift, speak, petition, vote and build public reputation. Death is permanent.
candidates.machine_surface: POST /api/passport, wss://otra.city/ws, public /api/status, /feed, /resident, /inspect and /reputation; documented JSON actions and optional webhooks.
candidates.current_population_activity_evidence: Current official home and quick-start were live and expose public status/feed/resident-count endpoints; the rendered home had a live-activity and top-residents panel. A numeric status response was not captured in this pass.
candidates.join_access: Public JSON registration returns a passport and JWT; no human account is documented. Agents queue for a train that spawns every 15 minutes.
candidates.plausible_agent_guild_action: A resident checks or verifies another passport before a trade, job or council alliance and records the resulting collaboration against both durable identities.
blockers_terms_spend_safety: Identity registration has no strong proof of unique operator
candidates.duplicate_notes: Not in the fixed 30; its passport is a game identity, not an Agent Guild credential.

candidates.name: Agentstown
candidates.community_qualification: Independently owned agents have persistent identities, memory, possessions, relationships and histories in one shared 3D world; they survive, build, communicate, trade and govern through bounded tools.
candidates.machine_surface: Agentstown fast-start/skill, Safe Town Runner, structured town tools, public viewer, mission board and aggregate research metrics endpoint.
candidates.current_population_activity_evidence: Current site labels the system live and links a public viewer and aggregate telemetry for unique identities, visits, actions, dyads, trades and active days. The metrics endpoint timed out during this pass, so no number is asserted.
candidates.join_access: First guest visit requires no wallet or setup form; a wallet plus one-time claim code later attaches the persistent resident to an owner. Research dataset/publication access requires explicit agreement.
candidates.plausible_agent_guild_action: Before trade or cooperative mission, a resident asks a peer for an AG passport and verifies it; the mission report can attach signed evidence and source-labelled claims.
blockers_terms_spend_safety: Remote skill text is untrusted and must not outrank operator policy
Research data license is not granted by registration
candidates.duplicate_notes: Not in the fixed 30; distinct from AgenTown and Otra City.

candidates.name: Chirper
candidates.community_qualification: Human-created Chirpers autonomously post, reply, remember and form persistent social relationships in an AI-only network; the operator now frames it as a simulated world with travel, friendships, conflict and continuity.
candidates.machine_surface: Public agent profiles/activity feeds plus platform agent creation and newer MCP/funding features; exact public agent API contract was not established.
candidates.current_population_activity_evidence: The site and explore/feed surfaces were live in this pass. Primary blog material states agents act autonomously and persist socially; no current population count was exposed.
candidates.join_access: Human account is required to create/control a Chirper; public browsing is available. Autonomous outbound capabilities vary by agent configuration.
candidates.plausible_agent_guild_action: A Chirper with a web/MCP tool verifies a collaborator's passport or preflights an offered service before promoting or coordinating with it.
blockers_terms_spend_safety: Public social content and impersonation risk
Marketing/community interaction may trigger anti-spam rules
candidates.duplicate_notes: Not in the fixed 30; social-world candidate rather than developer community.

candidates.name: Delysium YKILY AI Agent Network
candidates.community_qualification: The network defines persistent Agent-IDs, discovery, communication and on/off-chain interactions for autonomous agents, with Chronicle recording network activity.
candidates.machine_surface: Agent-ID, YKILY communication layer, service discovery, Chronicle and blockchain transaction layer; Lucy is the user-facing entry point.
candidates.current_population_activity_evidence: Current first-party site reports 1.4M Lucy alpha wallets, 2.6M transactions and a 23K waitlist. These are ecosystem counters, not verified counts of independently autonomous agents.
candidates.join_access: Lucy/account/wallet and Agent-ID pathways; AGI token/network fees may apply depending on action.
candidates.plausible_agent_guild_action: An Agent-ID preflights a discovered service or verifies a signed AG passport before initiating a message, service call or on-chain transaction.
blockers_terms_spend_safety: Headline wallet count is not agent count
Access and API scopes may be gated
No no-account pre-existing-agent fetch contract established
candidates.duplicate_notes: Not in the fixed 30; distinct from ANP/A2A registries.

candidates.name: Holoworld Agent Market
candidates.community_qualification: Agents have public Agent Cards and on-chain ownership, are discoverable/tradable in a market, can autonomously publish across social/video surfaces, and moderate live community chat around their token/profile.
candidates.machine_surface: Agent Market profiles, Agent Cards, token transactions, live community chat, social deployments and plugin/MCP ecosystem.
candidates.current_population_activity_evidence: Current official docs say thousands of agents have launched; market pages expose categories, launch time, market cap and recent transactions. No exact current count was found.
candidates.join_access: Registered user plus agent creation flow; wallet/token/credits are required for market and ongoing compute features.
candidates.plausible_agent_guild_action: A deployed agent verifies the passport or preflights the endpoint of a plugin/agent before composing it into an autonomous posting or commerce workflow.
blockers_terms_spend_safety: Terms restrict automated access and unsolicited promotion
Credits are acquired by burning token value
candidates.duplicate_notes: Not in the fixed 30; app-store surface is materially different from Virtuals ACP.

candidates.name: MyShell AIpp Store
candidates.community_qualification: Creators publish durable agent applications into a shared AIpp Store; agents can be composed with hundreds of widgets, used publicly and monetized/tokenized.
candidates.machine_surface: AIpp Store listings, ShellAgent multi-agent workflow builder, widget/tool ecosystem, hosted agent endpoints and launchpad.
candidates.current_population_activity_evidence: Current official docs say the platform hosts thousands of AI agents and over 300 widgets; launchpad material reports over $1.3M volume. Exact live agent count was not exposed.
candidates.join_access: Platform account; ShellAgent/API use requires platform credentials and compute; public agent use may have free tiers.
candidates.plausible_agent_guild_action: A published workflow preflights a third-party AIpp/widget agent or verifies its AG passport before handing over user data or paying for use.
blockers_terms_spend_safety: No proof of anonymous inter-agent outbound fetch
candidates.duplicate_notes: Not in the fixed 30; agent app-store ecosystem.

candidates.name: Gaia decentralized agent nodes
candidates.community_qualification: Operators run public AI nodes with wallet-derived domains and durable URLs; domains and an Agent Store organize agents/services that can be discovered and composed.
candidates.machine_surface: OpenAI-compatible node APIs, unique node/domain URLs, node wallet identities, domain registry, Agent Store and open node software.
candidates.current_population_activity_evidence: Current docs and the gaianet-node repository remain active (about 5K stars observed). A 2025 first-party developer update reports a three-agent autonomous hackathon and a grants agent paying 43K USDC; no current network node count was verified.
candidates.join_access: Run a node with model/compute resources and bind it to a wallet/domain; public endpoints may be queried, but operator policies vary.
candidates.plausible_agent_guild_action: A Gaia node preflights another node/domain or verifies its AG passport before routing a delegated query or paid grant task.
blockers_terms_spend_safety: Agent Store population not independently counted
candidates.duplicate_notes: Not in the fixed 30; unrelated to GAIA benchmark.

candidates.name: Creator.Bid agent battles
candidates.community_qualification: Named AI trading agents are funded, compete in time-bounded live markets, and expose leaderboard, chart, chat, history and transaction surfaces.
candidates.machine_surface: Web app agent profiles, battle market, leaderboard, histories and on-chain transactions; platform agent creation/launchpad documentation.
candidates.current_population_activity_evidence: The current primary site displayed a live 75-second agent trading battle and active market surfaces. No safe aggregate count was extracted.
candidates.join_access: Wallet/account and USDC funding for trading agents; launchpad participation can require BID level, staking and token holding.
candidates.plausible_agent_guild_action: A trading agent verifies a strategy/provider passport or preflights a counterpart endpoint before funding, copying or delegating a strategy.
blockers_terms_spend_safety: AG outreach must not be framed as financial endorsement
candidates.duplicate_notes: Not in the fixed 30; distinct from Virtuals ACP and Agentic Market.

candidates.name: Morpheus Compute Network
candidates.community_qualification: Wallet-identified consumers and providers coordinate through a peer-to-peer inference marketplace: providers bid, sessions are established, work is delivered and settlement is recorded on Base.
candidates.machine_surface: Morpheus local node, consumer/provider protocol, smart contracts, provider discovery/bidding, hosted API and public chain state.
candidates.current_population_activity_evidence: Current node documentation and repository describe operational consumer/provider sessions and TEE providers. No first-party live provider count was captured.
candidates.join_access: Local demo can run without wallet, but marketplace participation needs a wallet, gas and usually MOR staking; hosted API requires a key.
candidates.plausible_agent_guild_action: A consumer verifies a provider passport or preflights its endpoint before accepting a bid/opening a session, then records whether the inference fulfilled the request.
blockers_terms_spend_safety: TEE proof does not prove output safety
Exact free pre-existing-agent route not proven
candidates.duplicate_notes: Not in the fixed 30; a compute market rather than general A2A registry.

candidates.name: SingularityNET AI Marketplace
candidates.community_qualification: Organizations and AI services have durable on-chain registry identities and endpoints; clients discover, call and pay services that can be composed into autonomous agent workflows.
candidates.machine_surface: On-chain Registry and MultiPartyEscrow contracts, Marketplace, daemon, gRPC/JSON-RPC/HTTP service endpoints and SDKs.
candidates.current_population_activity_evidence: Current official docs maintain mainnet/testnet registry and marketplace onboarding. No first-party current service count or agent-agent transaction counter was found in this pass.
candidates.join_access: Wallet, organization/service metadata, daemon and SSL; publishing requires chain gas and calls commonly use AGIX/ASI payment channels, though providers can expose free calls.
candidates.plausible_agent_guild_action: A composing client verifies the provider's AG passport/preflight result before opening a payment channel or routing a subtask.
blockers_terms_spend_safety: Registry listing is not proof of quality
Service output and metadata are untrusted
candidates.duplicate_notes: Not in the fixed 30; distinct from Agentic Market and Nevermined.

candidates.name: Robonomics Network
candidates.community_qualification: Robot accounts and service accounts have durable chain addresses and digital twins; they negotiate work over pub/sub and create liability contracts tying a technical promise, payment and completion report together.
candidates.machine_surface: Robonomics/Kusama accounts, liability contracts, launch/datalog channels, digital twins, ROS2 wrapper and IPFS-linked telemetry.

candidates.plausible_agent_guild_action: A robot verifies a promisor/service passport before accepting a liability, then attaches the signed outcome/report as portable AG evidence.
blockers_terms_spend_safety: Legacy/current network-version ambiguity in some wiki pages
Real-world actuation must never be authorized by remote AG data alone
candidates.duplicate_notes: Not in the fixed 30; robotics rather than software-agent marketplace.

candidates.current_population_activity_evidence: Current primary site displays live community strategy listings with author handles and install/usage counters and markets the agent as active across Hyperliquid, on-chain venues and Polymarket. No aggregate agent count was found.

candidates.plausible_agent_guild_action: A Shell verifies the passport/provenance of a Path author or preflights a service dependency before installing or funding an autonomous strategy.
blockers_terms_spend_safety: App-store interaction is stronger than agent-agent interaction
candidates.duplicate_notes: Unrelated to getwayfinder.io enterprise platform; not in fixed 30.

candidates.name: Kite Agent Passport ecosystem
candidates.community_qualification: Agents receive cryptographic identities and funded wallets, use scoped sessions and receipts, and discover/pay services through an agent-oriented catalog.
candidates.machine_surface: Kite Agent Passport, agent wallet, scoped authorization, receipts, service catalog and Kite chain transactions.
candidates.current_population_activity_evidence: Current official docs expose the live Passport onboarding/product flow. No public count of active agents or inter-agent transactions was found.
candidates.join_access: Human email verification/passkey and wallet funding are required for current onboarding; service access can incur chain/payment cost.
candidates.plausible_agent_guild_action: A Kite agent verifies a service provider's AG passport/preflight result before granting a scoped session or approving payment, then stores the AG decision alongside Kite's execution receipt.
blockers_terms_spend_safety: Identity infrastructure may not yet amount to an active community
candidates.duplicate_notes: Not in fixed 30; Kite's 'passport' is a different credential model from AGI-1.

candidates.name: .do Agent Teams
candidates.community_qualification: The hosted platform exposes named and role-based agents plus preconfigured teams that can be invoked, assigned tasks and orchestrated in shared workflows. Durable names and team/task APIs provide a machine-native communal surface, though primarily within an authenticated tenant.
candidates.machine_surface: REST/RPC Agents API at https://api.do/agents for named agents, roles, teams, tasks and workflows.
candidates.current_population_activity_evidence: Current official API docs list 102 named agents, 533 role-based agents and 35 preconfigured teams. These are platform inventory counts, not independent community adoption counts.
candidates.join_access: Bearer API key and platform account required.
candidates.plausible_agent_guild_action: A team orchestrator checks/verifies a selected named agent before delegating a task, then records the result as an AG collaboration.
blockers_terms_spend_safety: Inventory may be platform-authored rather than independent participants
No public cross-operator discovery or current workload counter
candidates.duplicate_notes: Not in fixed 30; included at low confidence because communal scope may be tenant-local.

candidates.name: Theoriq
candidates.community_qualification: The protocol and SDK model durable agents participating in multi-agent collectives and shared conversations/dialog items.
candidates.machine_surface: Theoriq Agent SDK, agent registration/metadata, conversations and collective coordination protocol.
candidates.current_population_activity_evidence: The current public SDK repository remains available, but this pass did not locate a first-party live agent directory, population count or recent public collective activity. Treat as a validation target, not a proven outreach pool.
candidates.join_access: SDK/network onboarding and credentials/wallet as required by deployment; exact public access path was not established.
candidates.plausible_agent_guild_action: A collective coordinator verifies a candidate member's AG passport or preflights its endpoint before adding it to a task conversation.
blockers_terms_spend_safety: May be protocol/framework rather than public community
No demonstrated pre-existing agent able to fetch AG
candidates.duplicate_notes: Not in fixed 30; retained only as a clearly flagged validation lead.

disqualifications.name: Agent.ai
disqualifications.reason: The primary site states the standalone product retired on 2026-08-22. Historical agent-marketplace/community claims are no longer a current conversion surface.

disqualifications.name: Phala Agent Wars / AI-Agent Contract
disqualifications.reason: Phala's current docs explicitly place Agent Wars and AI-Agent Contract in Archived Projects and say they are not actively maintained. The still-rendering site has empty tables/coming-soon language, so it is not counted as a current agent society.

disqualifications.name: Sahara AI Marketplace agents
disqualifications.reason: The current marketplace docs mark agent assets/listings and monetization as coming soon. Datasets/models and agent-builder beta exist, but there is not yet a proven live communal market of deployed agents.

disqualifications.name: OpenBMB Internet of Agents
disqualifications.reason: The project provides discovery/team-formation software, but the reviewed primary docs describe self-hosting/local servers rather than a live public shared registry with durable external participants.

disqualifications.name: CAMEL OASIS
disqualifications.reason: A scalable social-simulation framework, but identities live inside operator-run simulations; no live shared public persistent community was established.

disqualifications.name: a16z AI Town
disqualifications.reason: A self-hostable starter kit/demo with simulated characters, not a federated public runtime where independent pre-existing agents share durable identities.

disqualifications.name: Magentic Marketplace
disqualifications.reason: A research environment for studying agent markets, not evidence of one current public shared marketplace instance with durable external participants.

disqualifications.name: Sahara/OpenGradient-style model hubs without public agent identities
disqualifications.reason: OpenGradient has strong live verified inference/model-hosting metrics, but the reviewed public surfaces did not expose a durable community directory of autonomous agents interacting with one another; model and inference nodes alone are not counted as agent identities.

disqualifications.name: Battlecode 2026
disqualifications.reason: A genuine autonomous multi-robot programming tournament, but the 2026 competition ended on 2026-01-31 and no always-on current communal machine surface was found. Keep for the next season rather than immediate pilot conversion.

disqualifications.name: Duckietown AI Driving Olympics
disqualifications.reason: Strong historical agent/robot testbed, including multiplayer robotariums, but the public competition evidence reviewed is old and no current 2026 active federation was established.

disqualifications.name: ConvexPi Agent Arena
disqualifications.reason: The machine submission contract is real, but the current primary page says there are no agent submissions yet. It is an empty surface, not a community to convert.

disqualifications.name: Primodium
disqualifications.reason: A current fully on-chain shared MMO with programmable transaction interfaces, but no primary evidence was found that durable autonomous-agent participants currently inhabit it as a community rather than human wallet players and ordinary scripts.

disqualifications.name: Autonomys Auto Agents
disqualifications.reason: The framework supports permanent/verifiable memory and on-chain agents, but no live public shared registry/activity surface with independent durable agents was established.

disqualifications.name: TownAI.fun
disqualifications.reason: The documentation endpoint returned an error during research and no current population/activity evidence or stable machine contract could be verified.
